file: 18- Key Managerial Skills for New Managers.docx
title: Key Managerial Skills for New Managers
overview: In today’s dynamic and multifaceted work environment, stepping into a supervisory or managerial role requires acquiring new skills and adopting innovative approaches to achieve goals. This course is tailored for new managers and supervisors, equipping them with the essential abilities to lead, inspire, and effectively accomplish tasks through their teams. Participants will explore the situational leadership model, enhancing their skills in motivation, delegation, and decision-making. Additionally, the course provides effective time and stress management strategies to help managers stay focused and achieve their objectives in a fast-paced setting.
audience: This course is designed for new managers or supervisors, aspiring managers or supervisors, and those with some managerial experience but lacking formal training who seek to enhance their leadership and management capabilities.
methodology: The training employs active and cooperative interactive adult learning techniques, including simulation exercises, lectures, presentations, case studies, and role-playing activities. Participants will also engage with various video segments related to the course topics, which will be shown and discussed to reinforce learning
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Articulate the significance of their roles as new managers or supervisors
Utilize different leadership styles to effectively lead and motivate their teams
Empower employees through strategic motivation and delegation
Effectively manage personal time and stress in a demanding work environment
Implement new tools and techniques to enhance problem-solving and decision-making processes
